description: Three collaborator management identity emblems and matching avatar frames, reconstructed from the existing owner-provided transparent reference. The self-contained SVGs embed WebP artwork and original CSS motion; they are not pure vector assets. Owner artwork was not supplied.
scope: Public management role explorer and automatic staff avatar/badge display for effective appointments. Artwork grants no management permission.

correction.reason: The original prismatic bloom and gem backlights reached the square SVG viewport edge. A radial alpha mask is applied only to the background light group, preserving all original embedded images, foreground frame/jewels, lettering and CSS animation bytes.
